title: LOW_HP_BOOST_SAVE: below 35% HP, do not spend boost (except zone escape or finishing an active P48 tree-retreat move); save it for when HP recovers. Movement direction unchanged, only the boost flag is withheld.
behaviors: when HP < LOW_HP_BOOST_FRAC (0.35) of max HP, t >= LOW_HP_BOOST_MIN_T (40 s), and the drop gate is open (no drop run/hold, no drop near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M): withhold the boost flag the champion would set on that tick (back-away retreat, building-cover retreat, crossfire break), after the silent cap so the move vector is unchanged; zone escape, the trip to the next circle, an active P48 'retreat, trees' move and the unstick jet keep their boost

evidence.source: Mech Watcher ladder study, 135 top-16 matches
evidence.finding: winners boost while below 35% HP only 19% of the time vs 37% for the bottom half; d -0.72; 90/112 matches

novelty_note: P53 only withholds the boost flag below 35% HP and never changes a movement target. P48 TREE_RETREAT changes where the hurt retreat goes (a tree-hidden spot) and keeps boost above 30% energy; P53 leaves that move and its boost intact (exception). P49 TREE_HEAL changes where the standing heal goes (silent walk, never boosts), so it has no boost to save. Earlier boost rules all ADDED boost: P31 LATE_HURT_BOOST (retired) ground-boosted the hurt retreat leg late, the opposite of P53; P26/P26b HEALTHY_BOOST (hold/retired) boosted long zone/drop legs while healthy. The champion's own rules boost on zone escape, late zone legs, every retreat and the crossfire break above 30% energy, and jet to unstick; the silent cap (Build 19) only scales speed when not boosting. No champion rule or tested idea ever removes boost at low HP.

hypothesis: Winners boost below 35% HP 19% of the time vs 37% (findings F9; P53.json evidence: d −0.72, 90/112 matches, correlation only). Withholding boost at low HP could save energy for later.
mechanism: LOW_HP_BOOST_SAVE_ON (LOW_HP_BOOST_FRAC 0.35, LOW_HP_BOOST_MIN_T 40): below 35% HP and t ≥ 40 s, withhold the boost flag the champion would set; move vector unchanged. Exceptions: zone escape, next-circle trip, active P48 tree retreat, unstick jet. SHA c57e009, PR #176.
positives: PR #176 body (practice bases, not an official screen): boost share at low HP 34.6% to 22.8% and 32.9% to 17.1%; no new pins; early deaths equal after the 40 s start fix.
negatives: PR #176: base 0 drop-ring arrivals 5 to 3 (seed 44, reported, not blocking). No official screen yet.
disproof: Step A under 10/192 (already passed at 117 and 123), more deaths before 40 s, empty energy into late fights, or official score ≤ 4.44.
outcome_detail: Promising but flawed: late low-HP boost saving produced survivals/late gains (2090, 4064, 5065; 4001 7->3, 4007 8->3) but withholding boost in mid-game fights (40-145 s) caused earlier deaths (e.g. 5024 2->13, death 143 s -> 56 s). Findings F14 (positive) and N5 (negative). Refinement P53b assigned.
